title: Left derived functor preserves distinguished triangles
statement: In Situation 05S8 [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization], let $(X,Y,Z,f,g,h)$ be a distinguished triangle of $\mathcal D$. If $LF$ is defined at two of $X,Y,Z$, then it is defined at the third, and $(LF(X),LF(Y),LF(Z),LF(f),LF(g),LF(h))$ is a distinguished triangle of $\mathcal D'$, where $LF(f),LF(g),LF(h)$ are the maps between values of [lem-pur-derived-functor-morphisms-05sa] and the target $LF(X[1])$ of $LF(h)$ is identified with $LF(X)[1]$ by the canonical isomorphism of [lem-pur-derived-functor-shift-05su].

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-derived-functor-triangles-05sc-third-value] in the X,Y case. In the Y,Z case apply it to T.rotate, then use the definedness equivalence of [lem-pur-derived-functor-shift-05su] backwards at X. In the Z,X case apply it to T.rotate.rotate after shifting definedness at X, then use the same equivalence backwards at Y. Rotation preserves distinguishedness by TR2 of [def-weil-triangulated-category]. This proves definedness at all three vertices.

Unpack definedness and the supplied-value predicate of [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization] to obtain LX,LY,LZ and the three natural cones with their retraction and common-stage certificates of [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram]. These are local witnesses in a Prop proof; no definition chooses an arbitrary witness.

Apply [lem-pur-derived-functor-morphisms-05sa] to mor1 and mor2 and the corresponding supplied cones. Extract their first denominator-square equations from the paired equations in that theorem. This constructs lf and lg.

Apply [lem-pur-derived-functor-triangles-05sc-value-triangle] to the extracted cones, their certificates and the two constructed maps. It supplies lh, its universal shifted equation and distinguishedness. Assemble the existential witnesses and conjunctions in the unchanged conclusion.
